# `ext::kv_log` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/kv_log.lani#L6)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Bitcask-style append-only log of CRC-32 records with an in-memory hash index of keys; values stay on disk and are read through a shared mapping. sync() (fdatasync) is the commit point; open() truncates at the first torn, oversized or bad-CRC record; compact() writes PATH.compact, fsyncs, renames over PATH and fsyncs the directory. Iteration follows Python dict order. A Python dict model passes 300 generated op-sequence cases (crash drops of the write buffer, reopens, exact file bytes) and 600 crash-injection cases (random truncation, bit flips, appended garbage, stale compaction file), plus a bad-header case. Single writer, no locking.
